title: Actual finite-Q3 split-step source-amplitude stress
question: Does the actual finite-Q3 split-step four-context recurrence remain within the fixed C=J=1 envelope when the local source amplitude is varied?
method: Rebuild the canonical quartic Q3 Hamiltonian independently on the target edge, square face, and 2x3 rectangular grid with oscillator truncation 3.
Evaluate the source word exp(i a(q_0+q_1)) at amplitudes {1/6,1/3,2/3,1,2} in the beta=1 Gibbs state.
Construct exact matrix exponentials for all onsite and lexicographic bond terms in both declared product orders, for both real-time signs and both A/A* contexts.
Measure the two-sided Gibbs q/p commutator seminorm for two split steps and test the registered local recurrence at every site and step.
Reconstruct the same grid in a separate implementation and compile the rational fixture cross-check in Lean R355.
finding: The primary lane passes 405/405 assertions and the independent lane passes 389/389. Both cover 120 parameter/context histories, 1440 length rows and 960 recurrence rows. The integrated verifier passes 372/372 with Lean R355 PASS. No recurrence residual exceeds the 1e-9 threshold. The primary maximum residual is 1.7513747338129368e-14, the minimum is -0.26820432407804784, and the maximum residuals by amplitude are 1.7513747338129368e-14 (1/6), 1.645530484965069e-14 (1/3), 1.3549546640955606e-14 (2/3), 1.189886717939869e-14 (1), and 1.1298525058628922e-14 (2).
decision_reason: The amplitude stress removes source amplitude as an immediate finite-grid counterexample to the declared split-step recurrence, while preserving exact split-product construction and independent agreement. The positive residuals are roundoff-scale and do not constitute an exact sign margin. The pass is therefore a finite source-family strengthening, not a source-uniform analytic theorem.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite actual-Q3 split-step source-amplitude stress. It does not prove a common-core recurrence, volume/cutoff/beta/source-degree uniformity, an exhaustion Cauchy estimate, a thermodynamic dynamics, a common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or a Clay result.

adversarial_review.check: Only five amplitudes, three volumes, one beta, two steps and one support are sampled; no source-degree or volume supremum is taken.
The largest positive residual is about 1.8e-14 while the acceptance threshold is 1e-9; this is tolerance-level roundoff, not exact nonpositivity.
Every tested history uses exact onsite-plus-bond split products in both orders; no unsplit Hamiltonian flow is substituted.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED for this finite construction; analytic split recurrence remains open

adversarial_review.check: Initial outside-support commutators are checked, but local algebra closure in the infinite-volume limit is not inferred.
R355 proves only rational amplitude-grid and scope fixtures; Python carries the matrix evidence.
No word-wise exhaustion convergence, common carrier, action intertwining, OS/KMS limit, GNS gap or continuum statement is present.
No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

qft_interface.closed: A reproducible finite split-step recurrence source-amplitude stress survives amplitudes 1/6 through 2 on the declared volumes, signs, adjoints and term orders, with independent reconstruction and Lean fixture support.
qft_interface.open: An analytic common-core recurrence, volume/cutoff/beta/source-degree uniformity, boundary commutator decay, exhaustion-compatible common word map, Hamiltonian-to-OS action intertwining, common alpha, KMS/GNS identification, phasewise gap and continuum remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6/Q3 finite evidence only; no heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.

next_action: Use the finite amplitude stress only as input and attack a source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform common-core recurrence; if that estimate fails, append its exact route-local obstruction before common-alpha or GNS-gap promotion.
